name: Progenitus
description: The five-headed Soul of the World of Alara, an enormously powerful being worshiped as a hydra-god.

description_citations.text: "Progenitus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A keeper watches the valley where Progenitus sleeps.
timeline.quote: He watches over the valley where Progenitus sleeps

citation.text: Keeper of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves believe Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
timeline.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

citation.text: Relic of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Following the Sundering of Alara, hydras are limited to the Shards of Naya and Jund; during the Conflux new hydras such as the Apocalypse Hydra come into conflict with other Shards.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux , new types of Hydras, like the Apocalypse Hydra , appeared that came into conflict with the other Shards, like Bant .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
timeline.quote: Fifteen years before the Conflux , Progenitus began to awaken, tearing the vegetation from its roots and ripping off huge sections of nearby mountains in an event later known as the Second Stirring.

citation.text: "Naya", section "The Second Stirring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An elf in sunsail tents in Naya's canopy watches over the valley of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: She's up there in her sunsail tents in Naya's canopy, watching over the valley of Progenitus

citation.text: "Topic Explosion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In Mayael's vision, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation.
timeline.quote: Progenitus had become displeased with creation and unleashed five storms to consume it

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cylia begs Progenitus for mercy and he blinds her.
timeline.quote: Furious at her impudence, Progenitus blinded the young girl

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cylia stabs Progenitus' mystical connection with a poisoned dagger, forcing him into a five-headed hydra form, wounded and dormant.
timeline.quote: With that one blow, Progenitus' divine essence scattered and his earthly body formed: a five-headed hydra.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Black and blue mana stir the withered heads of Progenitus, who bursts from his tomb in the Valley of the Ancient.
timeline.quote: His earthly tomb now open, Progenitus arched into the sky.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mayael perceives that the Anima's task is complete and regards Progenitus as the world made flesh.
timeline.quote: He is the world made flesh.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: Guided by the visions of the elvish prophet Mayael, the elves, the Nacatl, and the earthshaking behemoths of Naya march to war with its new neighbors.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Progenitus, the Soul of the World, returns.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

citation.text: Progenitus (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Ancient Ziggurat reappears when Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

citation.text: Ancient Ziggurat (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux black and blue mana flood Naya, and Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: Naya is now flooded with all five colors and Progenitus has awoken, roving the lands for inscrutable purposes.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shards merge, creating the Maelstrom and awakening Progenitus.
timeline.quote: It also reawakened the slumbering hydra-god Progenitus

citation.text: "Conflux (event)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Millennia before the Conflux, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation; Cylia wounds it with poisoned dagger, saving life on Alara though it had separated into Shards.
timeline.quote: Cylia dipped the dagger into the vial and flung her weapon into the being's heart

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Two heads of Progenitus wither away and it slumbers under Naya's soil.
timeline.quote: two of its heads withered away

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fifteen years before the Conflux, Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
timeline.quote: Progenitus began to awaken

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Second Stirring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Progenitus appears to Mayael asking for Cylia; Bolas co-opts its image to tell Mayael to build an army against Sarkhan Vol's dragons.
timeline.quote: The image of Progenitus was soon co-opted by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reunification of Alara reawakens Progenitus.
timeline.quote: the reunification of Alara reawakened Progenitus

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She believes Progenitus slumbers below Naya and sends visions to her people.
relations.quote: believing that the ancient hydra god Progenitus slumbers below Naya

citation.work: The Movers and Shakers of Naya
citation.text: "The Movers and Shakers of Naya". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: devote their lives to the hydra-god
relations.quote: Many elves devote their lives to the hydra, doing whatever they can to understand his will and keep him at peace.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: wounded him with a poisoned dagger
relations.quote: she flung her poisoned dagger straight into its ethereal heart

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: whisper strange, dire truths into Mayael's visions

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Hydras are regarded as manifestations of Progenitus, Alara's world soul.
relations.quote: Hydras are regarded as the manifestations of the "soul of the world" of Alara , the behemoth Progenitus .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Elves worship gargantuans as signs of Progenitus.
relations.quote: The elves worship the gargantuans of the plane, believing that the behemoths' actions are signs from Progenitus

citation.text: "Naya", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: The poison revealed Progenitus's true nature

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
